signatureStorage: Detached production signatures are release artifacts, not source-repository files. The controlled signed-release workflow emits each firmware image with a same-name .sig sidecar.

currentPolicy.applicationUpdate: BatteryMonitor.ino.bin is the signed plaintext application payload for SIGNED_USB_OTA_V1. Windows verifies it before trusted-USB transfer and the running ESP32 independently verifies it before selecting the inactive OTA partition.
currentPolicy.mergedImage: Current ESP-IDF release-mode Flash Encryption builds treat BatteryMonitor.ino.merged.bin as blank-device first-install only. It is not a post-encryption recovery image and must not be written as plaintext to an already encrypted unit.
